notes.title: Update - News
notes.content:
Hello everyone o/

For this first real update, I corrected some serious bugs that should make the game much more stable (complete changelog here) !
I also added the foundation of the next updates:
- Healing & Modules.

But what does that mean ?

Healing

Working for a secret society is not exactly an "healthy" thing to do (even when you are locked in a laboratory you can still be the one that other organisations try to kidnap) ^^

And during interventions shots can be fired, combats can broke up, people can be hurt, injured, or worse...

Happily, when the damages are not "too much" (aka when you don't die) you can also heal.

For now, only the "natural" healing is implemented, but the hospital update should come out this week end !

Modules

When you build something, the space used is sometime much more than what you really need, in others cases, a new technology allow you to build the same things in a much smaller scale.

But what to do with this empty space? Build a module of course!

The modules will be modifiers that you can add to any buildings and alter it's inner work.

For example, you could add a new turbine to this geothermal generator and produce more energy! Or maybe you will add a pharmacy to your clinic and allow the production of medicals supplies directly in the clinic?

The idea is to let YOU decide what's best for your gamestyle !

notes.title: Update - Changelog
notes.content:
Changelog:

Gameplay: 
- Added the possibility of a fight to happen during Interventions, it can result in the death of the employee.
- Also added: natural healing: given time, the employee can see their HP being restored, for more serious wound, a hospital will be needed (coming this weekend)
- I started to migrate the buildings to the new Module system, allowing more flexibility per building. It's not obvious yet since you can't add new modules, but it's planned for next week :)
- Improved the readability of the intervention's progress

Various:
- Corrected a bug where deleting all your save and clicking "load" was still loading a deleted file (so now it simply start a new game ^^)
- Added a help button on the new Intervention panel to help player navigate
- Added mouse support for the new intervention panel
- changed the key biding to the arrow keys
- Corrected a UI bug where the panel graphic was too short
- removed the artefact counter in the Resource bar since it's useless for now
- Corrected a bug where, sometime, the population display was not working
- Resized the text in the team name (on team creation)
- Resized the text in the dropdown to select a team for a new Intervention.

notes.title: Demo Available - What next?
notes.content:
Hello everyone o/

The demo is finally here !

Well, in theory, but since I have the main game, It seem I can't download the demo ^^"

Let me know in the discussion if there is a problem.

Remember that it's very much more like a draft than something with ton of gameplay, so if playing something starting is not your thing, pass on it and wait a few months ;)

On the duration of the demo, there should be around 15 min of gameplay if you do all the missions.

but what now?

Well, for me, still work to do, on the video game for sure, but on an other project as well (more news soon :p ).

For you, I will set a thread on the discussions for bug report and game talk.

Also, I will start to present the univers and gameplay mechanisms in a more detailed fashion.

As always, you can come on the discord to talk about the game directly :)

See you soon for more info !

notes.title: Price change and Happy new year!
notes.content:
Hello every one !

I hope that Christmas was good this year :)

What's new?

I was hoping to be able to contact you all sooner, but being away for family reasons do not help ^^"
Anyway, after discussing things with various people I have come to realize that my first price was too much for what I offered.

Furthermore the automatic pricing by steam is doing an simple automatic translation in local currency, where I wanted that the price to be a little more adapted.

In place of already asking for the final price, I will offer to the early bakers a discounted price, letting the game at 50% of it's final price and the price will be increased alongside the game's content is implemented.

You already bought the game and would like to benefit from the new pricing? 
First, let me thank you for the trust you place in me, but don't worry! you can still ask for a refund under normal steam limitations. If you want to support my work, you don't have anything to do.

Any questions? ask in the discussions, on the discord server or send me a message on my facebook page!

Where is the demo?

well, it is still being reviewed by the steam services, I guess even valves employees take a few days off during the year's end ^^

I'll keep you updated on the demo state  in a few days !
